AboutEST. SPRING 2027

USC's test kitchen, where students cook like chefs and eat like critics.

Chopped SC is USC's premier cooking club, for students who love food, whether you've never held a chef's knife or you already cook for your whole floor.

We meet three times a week. Tuesdays we cook in Chef Lab, Thursdays we sharpen technique in Skills Studio, and Saturdays we tour LA's restaurants on Beli and talk about what made each plate work.

The club was founded by Evelyn Jones, a USC Leventhal School of Accounting student who spent 12 years in hospitality before USC. She's bringing what she learned in restaurants to a kitchen full of Trojans.

Come cook with us

Cook together. Learn together. Tour LA on Beli.
